resources.string: On the page of the library, open the tab “Boxes”, section “Add a phone”, and tap “Pair”. Then scan the QR code shown there with this phone. The phone must be in the home network.
The QR code of the library
This is no QR code of the library.
The QR code is used up or expired. Tap “Pair” on the page again.
The library cannot be reached. Is the phone in the home network?
Hold a tag to the back of the phone, or tap a tile.
This phone cannot read tags: tap a tile.
NFC is switched off – switch it on in the settings of the phone, or tap a tile.
This tag is not linked yet. It is on the page of the library now.
This tag is linked to something the library does not have.
The next track is being loaded…
The album is not on the phone, and the library cannot be reached.
The album has played to its end. Put the tag on again to start it from the beginning.
This tag plays on a box.
This day of the calendar is not open yet. It opens on its date.
This app is too old for the library – install the new one.
The library is older than this app.
The library shows another certificate than the one this phone was paired with. Nothing is shown.
The page of the library cannot be reached: %s
Name of this phone in the library: %s
Albums are loaded when they are played and stay on the phone. When the limit is reached, the album played longest ago leaves.
No album is on the phone.
Unpair this phone from the library? The key, the albums on the phone and the progress are deleted here. The library keeps listing the phone until it is removed there.
Spotify cannot play here: is the Spotify app logged in, and the phone online?
For the registration of this app at Spotify (tab “Spotify” of the library): package name %1$s, SHA-1 %2$s, redirect URI %3$s.
The library has given no client ID: a tag of Spotify plays on a box.
The Spotify app is not installed: a tag of Spotify plays on a box.
